messages:
maria_marketing: Heads-up: customers reporting slower embeddings in eu-west. Need comms + status copy ASAP.

dan_ops: investigating now. appears tied to a recent KV-cache change increasing batch wait times for text-embed models. will confirm affected pools in ~10m.

claire_support: I've queued standard snippets. recommend we notify Dedicated & enterprise customers privately before public status.

leo_product: Draft short status blurb: 

"We are investigating elevated latency for embeddings in eu-west impacting some customers. Engineers are reverting a recent runtime change. No customer data compromised. Next update in 30 minutes. Workaround: use eu-north or embed-lite."

maria_marketing: timing: private email to accounts > $20k ARR within 10m, post 'Investigating' to status page at +20m after scope confirmed, hold public social until mitigation verified. Add a 10-minute incident note to tomorrow's webinar agenda.

sophie_sales: please flag any active POCs. i'll proactively contact top ARR accounts.

dan_ops: confirmed affected: eu-west1 pools for text-embed-large and text-embed-xxl; rollback started on one pool, monitoring. ETA full verification 25-35m.

incident_bot: Incident INC-2026-0501 created: severity P2, status: investigating. Runbook: rollback -> staging perf check -> gradual restore -> customer updates.

maria_marketing: final short statuspage copy ready to go in 20m. i'll prepare enterprise email now. tagging @dan_ops @claire_support @sophie_sales. :white_check_mark:
